title: Identity unit for the specified common-stage compositor
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite-field datum D and a geometric space T over D [def-sf-adic-realization-isomorphism-data], with l invertible at each residue field. There exists e:commonStageDerivedPullback(l,Qbar_l,id_T)≅Id. For every common-stage constructible object M, the hom of pullbackTensorCommonComposition(l,Qbar_l,id_T,id_T,M), followed by e at the identity-pullback object, is heterogeneously equal to that object identity. The pullback functor and compositor are the specified maps of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and [def-pod-rational-common-pullback-composition]; no new compositor is chosen.

source.place: BS Remark 6.8.15; HRS Lemma 7.9; explicit subargument of lem-sf-adic-reindexing-core, not a verbatim statement of either source.

proof.text: At finite coefficient complexes use the ordinary inverse-image identity comparison on sections. Its twice-identity composition equation is the identity adjunction equation. The completed integral comparison is fixed by quotient-system realization, so the same identity holds after inserting the specified completion units.

Localize the components and inverse components to the raw rational category. Scalar compatibility of the fixed completion units identifies them after finite field extension, so common-field arrow representatives give naturality of their common-stage inclusions. Use the literal-object transports in the pullback specification at the endpoints.

The defining representative formula of pullbackTensorCommonComposition identifies its twice-identity component with the rational one at the object own finite field. Apply the integral identity cancellation localized to that field. The literal-object transports give exactly the displayed HEq rather than a change of compositor.

theorem exists_common_pullback_identity_unit (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (T : GeometricSpace D)
    [∀ x : T.base.left, Invertible (l : T.base.left.residueField x)] :
    ∃ e : commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) (𝟙 T.base.left) ≅ 𝟭 _,
    ∀ M : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) T.base.left,
      HEq
        ((pullbackTensorCommonComposition l (PadicAlgCl l) (𝟙 T.base.left) (𝟙 T.base.left) M).hom ≫
          e.hom.app ((commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) (𝟙 T.base.left)).obj M))
        (𝟙 ((commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) (𝟙 T.base.left)).obj M))
